value: The operations desk runs 24/7. Account managers are available Monday to Friday, 7:00 to 19:00.
The six hubs are KRN, MAV, HLM, TRB, WYN and ORS.
Cargo claims must be lodged within 21 days of delivery.
A shipment more than 24 hours late is escalated to its account manager.
Contract CC-17 carries liability of 8.50 per kilogram.
Contract CC-22 carries liability of 12.00 per kilogram.
Contract CC-31 carries liability of 6.00 per kilogram.
The peak season surcharge is 4.5 percent of the freight charge from 2026-11-16 to 2026-12-24.
Standard pallets may not exceed 1.8 metres in height including the load.
All hubs are closed on 2026-12-25.
Every reroute needs a human approval before it takes effect.
The shipper on TG-604118 asked to be called about any delay longer than 12 hours.
TG-604227 is two pallets of glazed tiles and must stay upright.
TG-604305 carries fragile glassware and the shipper prefers the fewest hub handoffs.
The consignee for TG-604412 accepts deliveries only between 8:00 and 17:00.
TG-604590 was delivered and signed for on 2026-10-12.
The shipper on TG-604677 prefers updates through the customer portal, not by call.
TG-604733 is a temperature-sensitive load that must stay below 18 degrees.
The Wyncliff Rail Yard (WYN) is closed until further notice because of yard works.
The Holmquay Port Terminal (HLM) is congested and does not accept reroutes.
Freight arriving at a hub after its daily cutoff is sorted the next day.
